topic: A waitlist for a pocket-sized habit tracker app launching soon (fictional business — example)

facts.name: Pocketstreak
facts.claim: A habit tracker that fits on one screen, reminds you once, then gets out of the way
facts.howItWorks: Join the waitlist, get an invite when your spot opens, install and start your first habit in a minute
facts.audience: People who want a lighter way to build habits
facts.faq: Is the waitlist free? | Yes, joining costs nothing ; When will I get an invite? | Invites go out in the order people joined ; Which phones will it run on? | It will run on the phone browser first
